title: Cheat Sheet
markdown:
## Pointer basics

| Code | Means | Lesson |
|---|---|---|
| `&x` | the address of `x` | 1.01 |
| `int* p{ &x };` | `p` holds `x`'s address | 1.02 |
| `*p` | the object `p` points at (read or write) | 1.03 |
| `p->m` | `(*p).m`: member of the pointed-at struct | 1.03 |
| `nullptr` | "points at nothing"; check before `*p` | 1.02 |
| `const int* p` | cannot write through `p` | 1.03 |
| `int* const p` | `p` itself cannot be re-pointed | 1.03 |
| `int** pp` | pointer to a pointer; `**pp` is the int | 3.02 |
| `void*` | an address of anything; `static_cast` back to the real type | 3.05 |

## Arithmetic and arrays

| Code | Means | Lesson |
|---|---|---|
| `a[i]` | `*(a + i)` | 2.01 |
| `p + n` | `n` **elements** on (`n * sizeof(*p)` bytes) | 2.02 |
| `q - p` | elements between them (`std::ptrdiff_t`) | 2.02 |
| `end = begin + count` | one past the end: compare, never dereference | 2.02 |
| `y * stride + x` | element `(x, y)` of strided 2D data | 2.04 |
| `reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(&obj)` | view any object's bytes | 2.05 |
| `std::memcpy(&v, bytes + off, sizeof v)` | read a value out of a byte buffer | 2.05 |
| `std::bit_cast<std::uint32_t>(f)` | reinterpret bits safely (C++20) | 2.05 |

## Layout

| Rule | Lesson |
|---|---|
| members are placed in declaration order at offsets that are multiples of their alignment | 3.01 |
| `sizeof(struct)` is rounded up to its largest alignment | 3.01 |
| largest members first wastes the least padding | 3.01 |
| `offsetof(T, member)` gives a member's offset | 3.01 |
| a class with virtual functions starts with a hidden vtable pointer | 3.05 |

## Lifetime

| Storage | Where | Ends | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| static | program image | program exit | 4.01 |
| automatic | stack frame | end of its block | 4.02 |
| dynamic | heap | when freed | 4.03 |

| Allocate | Free with |
|---|---|
| `new T` | `delete` |
| `new T[n]` | `delete[]` |
| `malloc`/`calloc`/`realloc` | `free` |
| `std::make_unique<T>()` | automatic |
| `std::make_shared<T>()` | automatic, when the last owner goes |

## Owning and borrowing

| Type | Role | Lesson |
|---|---|---|
| `T` (a value), `std::vector<T>` | owns, copies deeply | 4.04 |
| `std::unique_ptr<T>` | sole owner, move only | 5.02 |
| `std::shared_ptr<T>` | shared owner, reference counted | 5.03 |
| `std::weak_ptr<T>` | observes a shared object; `lock()` to use | 5.03 |
| `T*`, `T&` | borrows | 4.04 |
| `std::span<T>`, `std::string_view` | borrows a sequence | 5.04 |

## Allocators

| Allocator | Allocate | Free | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| general heap | find a fit, split | mark free, coalesce | 6.01 |
| arena | bump an offset | reset everything | 6.02 |
| pool | pop the free list | push the free list | 6.03 |

`alignUp(v, a) = (v + a - 1) & ~(a - 1)` · page = `address >> 12` · offset = `address & 0xFFF`

## Debug fill patterns (MSVC Debug)

| Bytes | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `CC` | uninitialised stack |
| `CD` | heap memory never written |
| `DD` | freed heap memory |
| `FD` | guard bytes around heap blocks |
| `FEEEFEEE` | freed back to the Windows heap |
